candidates: Do not remove existing comments when modifying a source file. Flag any diff that drops inline comments, block comments, JSDoc blocks, TODO annotations, attribution lines (e.g. `// copied from …`), or rationale notes explaining workarounds (e.g. the PrismJS race-condition block comment above `Code` in syntaxhighlighter.tsx). Request that all such comments be restored, even if the surrounding code was legitimately changed.

When nesting content inside the project's `ScrollArea` (or the `Scroller` styled component), ensure every intermediate wrapper element — including child `div` elements and `pre` elements — is given both `width: 'fit-content'` and `maxWidth: '100%'`. Without these constraints on every level, the `ScrollArea` component will not scroll correctly and content may overflow.

When a shared UI component is modified, require the author to audit every known consumer of that component for regressions before the MR is approved. For `SyntaxHighlighter` specifically, the known call sites to check are: `code/addons/docs/src/blocks/blocks/SourceContainer.tsx`, `code/addons/docs/src/blocks/components/Source.tsx`, `code/addons/docs/src/blocks/components/ArgsTable/ArgValue.tsx`, `code/addons/a11y/src/components/Report/Details.tsx`, `code/addons/onboarding/src/Onboarding.tsx`, and `code/core/src/shared/checklist-store/checklistData.tsx`.
